description: A 720p video driven by your voice-over or music: send an MP3 or WAV (up to 20 seconds) and a prompt, optionally a starting image. The video is as long as the audio and keeps it. Compared with other video tools: budget. Price: from $0.027 per second (one call: from $0.136 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.136, 10 $0.271, 15 $0.406, 20 $0.541 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

audio.description: Your voice-over or music as an MP3 or WAV link; the video is exactly as long as this audio and keeps it as its soundtrack. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

image.description: Optional starting image (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

max_seconds.description: Longest the audio can be; sets the price. Longer audio is refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

name: video-p-video-voice
title: P-Video from your own audio
